# v3-A: why 1,775 of the 20,000 designed configurations have no usable autotuned flight.
# Tabulated from the per-run status files, autotune outputs and failure lists on the simulation hosts, which are not
# deposited (not regenerated by reproduce_paper.sh). The by-airframe and by-payload counts are reproducible from the
# deposit with scripts/analysis/v3a_attrition.py (results/campaign_v3a/v3a_attrition.txt).

    1100 no tuned controller (autotune returned no gains)
    481 flown twice, takeoff timeout
    166 in results but only a failed-attempt row
    22 failed in an earlier re-scoring pass (terminal)
    6 other (tuned, no valid scored flight)
